name: hcapp_setEventAttendence
description: Records or updates a hasher's attendance at an event. Supports two hasher-resolution modes: direct by @hasherId, or QR code scan via @qrScanText (resolved from HC.Hasher.QR_code). If @hemId is supplied the hasher is resolved from the HEM row, supporting visitor/virgin rows that share the KennelId as UserId. Guards against removing attendance when a non-cancelled payment exists. Updates Event.Hares string aggregate when @isHare changes. Returns a richer ad-hoc rowset in scan mode (payment and member status). Delegates to hcapp_syncEventAdminData or hcapp_syncUserData based on @returnUserRecords.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Used by ValidateAppAuth to resolve the calling user.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated by ValidateAppAuth against the device secret.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to update. In QR scan mode, may be a PublicEventId — resolved to the internal Event.id via HC.Event.PublicEventId lookup before use.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: Target hasher. NULL and no @qrScanText = defaults to calling user. NULL with @qrScanText = resolved from QR code. Overwritten from @hemId row if @hemId is provided.

parameters.name: attendenceState
parameters.description: New attendance state. Must be 0–40. 0–19=not at run, 20–29=on trail, 30+=On Inn. Validated server-side; NULL or out-of-range returns error.

parameters.name: isHare
parameters.description: Hare flag. Sentinel value -1 is normalised to NULL at the start of the SP (means: keep existing value). NULL = do not update IsHare. 1 = mark as hare.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark cursor passed through to the delegated sync SP. NULL is coalesced to 'ignore' before delegation.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark cursor passed through to the delegated sync SP. NULL is coalesced to 'ignore' before delegation.

parameters.name: returnUserRecords
parameters.description: Delegation selector. Default 0 = delegate to hcapp_syncEventAdminData. 1 = delegate to hcapp_syncUserData.

parameters.name: qrScanText
parameters.description: QR code text from the hasher's app (e.g. 'UQR:...'). When provided, resolves @hasherId via HC.Hasher.QR_code and triggers the extended scan ad-hoc rowset. Mutually exclusive with a non-null @hasherId.
parameters.typeMismatch: Widened from NVARCHAR(50) in HC5 to NVARCHAR(250) in HC6, matching HC.Hasher.QR_code column length.

parameters.name: hemId
parameters.description: Direct HEM lookup by id, used for visitor/virgin rows. When provided, @hasherId is resolved from the HEM row. @hemId.EventId must match @eventId — mismatch returns an error (errorCode 1224, errorType 12).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Write SP success/failure envelope. Always present as the first rowset. success=1 means the write succeeded; success=0 means it failed (see rowset 1 for error detail). errorCode and errorType are NULL on success.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 = operation succeeded, 0 = operation failed.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific numeric error code. NULL on success. Auth failures from ValidateAppAuth do not emit the envelope; they emit error detail directly.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error category code. NULL on success. Codes used: 12=validation (attendenceState out of range, mismatched hemId/eventId), 13=not found (QR code unrecognised), 5=business rule (payment blocks removal), 19=unhandled database error.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Present only when success=0. Carries the structured error detail. One of three cases: auth failure from ValidateAppAuth (emitted WITHOUT the preceding Envelope row); validation/business error (emitted AFTER the Envelope row with success=0); or unhandled CATCH error (also AFTER the Envelope row with success=0). Note: auth failure from ValidateAppAuth skips the envelope entirely and emits this as rowset 0.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry, or a NEWID() generated inline for business-rule errors (payment guard).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error category code (matches errorType in the Envelope).

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific error code (matches errorCode in the Envelope).

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Short human-readable error title.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing error message. Payment-guard message includes the hasher's display name.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: SP name from OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: AdHocNonScanResult
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on success when @qrScanText IS NULL. Contains the updated attendance state and HEM id.

columns.name: adHocDataId
columns.description: Always 1. Identifies this as an ad-hoc data rowset.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: Human-readable attendance confirmation. Varies by attendenceState (on trail, On Inn, not at run) and whether the hasher is the caller.

columns.name: hasherEventMapId
columns.description: The HEM record id (HC.HasherEventMap.id) after the write.

columns.name: hasherId
columns.description: The resolved hasher's id (HC.Hasher.id).

columns.name: attendenceState
columns.description: Re-read attendance state after the update (HC.HasherEventMap.AttendenceState).

rowsets.name: AdHocScanResult
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on success when @qrScanText IS NOT NULL. Richer than the non-scan shape — includes payment status, membership, notification prefs, and discount info. Note: column name for the message is 'userMessage' here, not 'serverMessage' (see code smells).

columns.name: adHocDataId
columns.description: Always 1.

columns.name: userMessage
columns.description: Human-readable attendance confirmation. Same logic as serverMessage in the non-scan rowset.

columns.name: isPaid
columns.description: Count of non-cancelled Payment rows for this HEM (HC.Payment where CancelledBy_UserId IS NULL). 0 = not paid, >0 = paid.

columns.name: isMember
columns.description: 1 if HasherKennelMap.MembershipExpirationDate > GETDATE(), else 0. NULL if no HasherKennelMap row.

columns.name: hasherEventMapId
columns.description: The HEM record id (HC.HasherEventMap.id).

columns.name: hasherId
columns.description: The resolved hasher's id (HC.Hasher.id).

columns.name: notificationPreference
columns.description: COALESCE(HasherEventMap.EventNotificationPreference, HasherKennelMap.KennelNotificationPreference). NULL if both are NULL.

columns.name: emailAlertPreference
columns.description: COALESCE(HasherEventMap.EventEmailAlertPreference, HasherKennelMap.KennelEmailAlertPreference). NULL if both are NULL.

columns.name: currentHaringCount
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.CurrentHaringCount. COALESCE to -1 if no HasherKennelMap row.

columns.name: currentPackRunCount
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.CurrentPackRunCount. COALESCE to -1 if no HasherKennelMap row.

columns.name: rsvpState
columns.description: HasherEventMap.RsvpState. COALESCE to -1 if no HEM row exists for the hasher at this event.

columns.name: willHareState
columns.description: HasherEventMap.IsHare. COALESCE to 0 if no HEM row.

columns.name: hares
columns.description: HC.Event.Hares — comma-separated string of hare display names as of the current write. COALESCE to '' if NULL.

columns.name: discountAmount
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.DiscountAmount. COALESCE to 0 if no HasherKennelMap row.

columns.name: discountPercent
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.DiscountPercent. COALESCE to 0 if no HasherKennelMap row.

columns.name: discountDescription
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.DiscountDescription. COALESCE to '' if no HasherKennelMap row.

rowsets.name: SyncRowsets
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ are the full output of the delegated sync SP (hcapp_syncEventAdminData or hcapp_syncUserData). The caller receives all rowsets from the sync call appended after the ad-hoc rowset. Structure varies by which sync SP is called.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET AttendenceState (and optionally RsvpState=3, IsHare) WHERE id=@hemId — when @hemId is not null
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — when no existing HEM row is found for the hasher+event combination
UPDATE HC.Event SET Hares, updatedAt — when @isHare IS NOT NULL, recomputes STRING_AGG of hare display names
EXEC HC.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser @userId=@hasherId — when attendance crosses the 20 threshold (added or removed from run). Runs AFTER the transaction commit.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on validation error, auth error, or unhandled exception

codeSmells.issue: Two incompatible ad-hoc rowset column names for the message field
codeSmells.detail: Non-scan path (rowset 1): message column is 'serverMessage'. QR-scan path (rowset 1): message column is 'userMessage'. Callers must branch on whether @qrScanText was set to know which column name to read. An inconsistency carried forward from HC5 — should be unified to a single name in a future revision.

codeSmells.issue: Auth failure bypasses the write SP envelope
codeSmells.detail: When ValidateAppAuth rejects the request (lines 82–88), the SP emits TWO rowsets with success=0 and errorDetail as separate rowsets — without the standard write-SP envelope at rowset 0. Callers checking 'rowset 0 = envelope, rowset 1 = detail' will misparse auth failures. Other errors (validation, business, CATCH) correctly emit the envelope at rowset 0 then detail at rowset 1.

codeSmells.issue: PublicEventId resolution only attempted in scan mode
codeSmells.detail: The COALESCE lookup on HC.Event.PublicEventId (lines 141–143) is inside an IF (@qrScanText IS NOT NULL) block. Non-scan callers who pass a PublicEventId as @eventId will not have it resolved and will receive a silent no-op or wrong-event write. This should apply unconditionally.

codeSmells.issue: Hares aggregate computed from post-write DB state but @isHare sentinel check is incomplete
codeSmells.detail: The Hares STRING_AGG (lines 276–283) fires when @isHare IS NOT NULL after sentinel normalisation. But the new HEM INSERT (lines 262–270) always sets IsHare=0 regardless of @isHare. If a new HEM is inserted with @isHare=1, the Hares recompute will include the new row's IsHare=0 value, not the intended 1, because the INSERT happens before the Hares update and the UPDATE path is taken only for existing HEM rows.

codeSmells.issue: Payment guard does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The payment-block error path (lines 210–218) constructs a NEWID() errorId inline but does not INSERT into HC.ErrorLog. All other error paths in this SP (validation, auth, CATCH) log to HC.ErrorLog. The payment guard is inconsistent — the errorId returned to the caller is not persisted.

codeSmells.issue: isMember computed as SMALLINT but returned as a derived CASE expression
codeSmells.detail: The @isMember variable is declared SMALLINT (line 313) and set via a CASE expression. The value is always 0 or 1, matching the pattern, but callers should be aware the column is SMALLINT not BIT.

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hard-coded to '<unknown>' in all ErrorLog inserts
codeSmells.detail: HC.ErrorLog.HcVersion is set to the literal '<unknown>' string rather than a real version identifier. This was acceptable as a placeholder but should be replaced with the deployed version string once a versioning mechanism is in place.

breakingChanges: @qrScanText widened from NVARCHAR(50) to NVARCHAR(250) to match the HC.Hasher.QR_code column width. Existing callers passing strings <= 50 chars are unaffected.
TRY/CATCH transaction added — HC5 had no error handling or transaction boundary. The write is now atomic; partial updates on SQL error no longer occur.
Success envelope rowset added as rowset 0 (success BIT, errorCode INT, errorType INT). HC5 callers reading rowset 0 as the ad-hoc result will now read the envelope instead.
Ad-hoc result is now rowset 1 (not rowset 0). Callers must advance one rowset to read the ad-hoc data.
HC.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser is now called after the transaction commit (outside TRY/CATCH). In HC5 it was called without a transaction at all.
Delegation targets updated to HC6 SPs (HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData, HC6.hcapp_syncUserData) — HC5 called the HC5 equivalents.
Auth model changed from HC5 shared-secret pattern to HC6 ValidateAppAuth helper SP.
